rows.name: US equity market
rows.paper: Common Risk Factors in the Returns on Stocks and Bonds
rows.rule: Hold the value-weighted CRSP market.

rows.name: 60/40 SPY / IEF
rows.paper: 60/40 portfolio
rows.rule: 60% SPY, 40% IEF, rebalanced monthly.

rows.name: Size (small minus big)
rows.paper: The Relationship between Return and Market Value of Common Stocks
rows.rule: Long small caps, short large caps (FF SMB, 2x3 sorts).

rows.name: Value (book-to-market)
rows.paper: The Cross-Section of Expected Stock Returns
rows.rule: Long high B/M, short low B/M (FF HML).

rows.name: Value (earnings yield)
rows.paper: Investment Performance of Common Stocks in Relation to Their Price-Earnings Ratios
rows.rule: Long top-quintile E/P, short bottom quintile, value-weighted.

rows.name: Value (cash-flow yield)
rows.paper: Contrarian Investment, Extrapolation, and Risk
rows.rule: Long top-quintile CF/P, short bottom quintile.

rows.name: Dividend yield
rows.paper: The Effect of Personal Taxes and Dividends on Capital Asset Prices
rows.rule: Long top-quintile D/P, short bottom quintile.

rows.name: Momentum (12-1)
rows.paper: Returns to Buying Winners and Selling Losers
rows.rule: Long past 12-1 month winners, short losers (FF UMD).
rows.costs: Gross of costs (published portfolio); high turnover

rows.name: Short-term reversal
rows.paper: Evidence of Predictable Behavior of Security Returns
rows.rule: Long last month's losers, short last month's winners.
rows.costs: Gross of costs (published portfolio); very high turnover

rows.name: Long-term reversal
rows.paper: Does the Stock Market Overreact?
rows.rule: Long 5-year (t-60..t-13) losers, short winners.

rows.name: Profitability
rows.paper: The Other Side of Value: The Gross Profitability Premium
rows.rule: Long robust operating profitability, short weak (FF RMW).

rows.name: Investment (asset growth)
rows.paper: Capital Investments and Stock Returns
rows.rule: Long conservative investors, short aggressive (FF CMA).

rows.name: Accruals
rows.paper: Do Stock Prices Fully Reflect Information in Accruals and Cash Flows About Future Earnings?
rows.rule: Long lowest-accrual quintile, short highest.

rows.name: Net share issuance
rows.paper: Share Issuance and Cross-Sectional Returns
rows.rule: Long net repurchasers, short top-quintile issuers.

rows.name: Low beta (raw)
rows.paper: The Capital Asset Pricing Model: Some Empirical Tests
rows.rule: Long lowest-beta quintile, short highest (dollar-neutral, not beta-neutral).

rows.name: Low volatility
rows.paper: The Cross-Section of Volatility and Expected Returns
rows.rule: Long lowest total-variance quintile, short highest.

rows.name: Low idiosyncratic volatility
rows.paper: The Cross-Section of Volatility and Expected Returns
rows.rule: Long lowest residual-variance quintile, short highest.

rows.name: Value + momentum combo
rows.paper: Value and Momentum Everywhere
rows.rule: 50% HML + 50% UMD.

rows.name: Betting against beta
rows.paper: Betting Against Beta
rows.rule: Long levered low-beta, short de-levered high-beta; beta-neutral (AQR, US).

rows.name: Quality minus junk
rows.paper: Quality Minus Junk
rows.rule: Long profitable, growing, safe, high-payout firms; short junk (AQR, US).

rows.name: Industry momentum
rows.paper: Do Industries Explain Momentum?
rows.rule: Rank 49 industries on 6-month return; long top 7, short bottom 7; monthly.
rows.costs: Gross; built from French industry returns

rows.name: Return seasonality
rows.paper: Seasonality in the Cross-Section of Stock Returns
rows.rule: Industry-level version: rank 49 industries on their average return in the same calendar month over the prior 20 years; long top 7, short bottom 7.
rows.costs: Gross; built from French industry returns

rows.name: Factor momentum
rows.paper: Factor Momentum and the Momentum Factor
rows.rule: Each month, long each of 7 FF factors with positive trailing 12-month return, short those with negative; equal-weight.

rows.name: Value & momentum everywhere (global)
rows.paper: Value and Momentum Everywhere
rows.rule: 50/50 value and momentum across 8 asset classes (AQR 'Everywhere').

rows.name: Time-series momentum (diversified)
rows.paper: Time Series Momentum
rows.rule: Long futures with positive 12-month return, short negative; vol-scaled, 58 markets (AQR).

rows.name: Volatility-managed market
rows.paper: Volatility-Managed Portfolios
rows.rule: Scale market exposure by 16% / last month's realized vol, capped at 2x.

rows.name: Volatility-managed momentum
rows.paper: Momentum Has Its Moments
rows.rule: Scale UMD to 12% target vol using prior 6-month daily vol, capped at 2x.

rows.name: 10-month moving-average timing
rows.paper: A Quantitative Approach to Tactical Asset Allocation
rows.rule: Hold US market when total-return index > 10-month SMA, else T-bills.

rows.name: Absolute momentum on the market
rows.paper: Absolute Momentum: A Simple Rule-Based Strategy
rows.rule: Hold US market when trailing 12-month excess return > 0, else T-bills.

rows.name: Sell in May (Halloween)
rows.paper: The Halloween Indicator, 'Sell in May and Go Away'
rows.rule: Hold US market November-April, T-bills May-October.

rows.name: January small-cap effect
rows.paper: Size-Related Anomalies and Stock Return Seasonality
rows.rule: Hold SMB in January only; flat the rest of the year.

rows.name: Turn of the month
rows.paper: Equity Returns at the Turn of the Month
rows.rule: Hold US market on the last trading day of the month and the first 3 of the next; T-bills otherwise.

rows.name: Avoid Mondays (weekend effect)
rows.paper: Stock Returns and the Weekend Effect
rows.rule: Hold US market every day except Monday.

rows.name: Pre-holiday effect
rows.paper: High Stock Returns before Holidays
rows.rule: Hold US market only on the trading day before a market holiday (1953+).

rows.name: Overnight drift (SPY)
rows.paper: Return Differences between Trading and Non-Trading Hours
rows.rule: Buy SPY at the close, sell at the next open; cash intraday.

rows.name: GTAA 5-asset trend (Faber)
rows.paper: A Quantitative Approach to Tactical Asset Allocation
rows.rule: 20% each in SPY, EFA, IEF, VNQ, DBC when above 10-month SMA, else that sleeve in T-bills.

rows.name: Global equities momentum (dual momentum)
rows.paper: Risk Premia Harvesting Through Dual Momentum
rows.rule: If SPY 12m > T-bills, hold the stronger of SPY/EFA; else AGG.

rows.name: Sector momentum rotation
rows.paper: Relative Strength Strategies for Investing
rows.rule: Hold the 3 of 9 SPDR sectors with the best 12-month return, equal weight.

rows.name: Risk parity (inverse vol)
rows.paper: Leverage Aversion and Risk Parity
rows.rule: Inverse 63-day-vol weights across SPY, EFA, TLT, IEF, GLD, DBC, VNQ; unlevered; monthly.
